integrity: Original sector matching and elementary proof; independent audit and external validation not performed. Numerical checker is supplementary and cannot establish a universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Applies to four-sector ideal Filippov relay with k>0 and transverse periodic orbits beginning (A,0), A>2k. No complete sliding/escaping classification, stability of a general regularization, or theorem about isolated cycles under additional perturbations. Literature comparisons do not prove exhaustive priority.
title: Exact non-isochronous crossing annulus and sharp grazing in a four-sector relay oscillator
